content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The consultancy fee and other terms and conditions shall be in accordance with the OM. No.46324/FD/F3/2026 dated 27-08-2026 of the Finance Department, Puducherry. Engagement will be on a full-time basis initially for a period of six months. Purely of temporary nature against specific jobs. Appointment will be cancelled at any time without assigning any reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Oulgaret Municipality Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Oulgaret Municipality Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Consultant (Office Manager), 1 Consultant (Store Keeper).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Oulgaret Municipality Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the notification PDF) and send it to The Commissioner, Oulgaret Municipality, Puducherry, by by post or in person, to reach by 31 October 2026.
